title: 2024 AMC 12B Problem 15
statement: A triangle in the coordinate plane has vertices \(A(\log_2 1, \log_2 2),\) \(B(\log_2 3, \log_2 4),\) and \(C(\log_2 7, \log_2 8).\) What is the area of \(\triangle ABC?\)

solutions.text:
The vertices are \(A = (0, 1),\) \(B = (\log_2 3, 2),\) \(C = (\log_2 7, 3).\) By the shoelace formula, \[ \begin{gathered} [\triangle ABC]\\ {}=\tfrac12\,\bigl|2\log_2 3-\log_2 7\bigr|. \end{gathered} \]

This equals \(\tfrac12\log_2 \dfrac{9}{7} = \log_2 \sqrt{\tfrac{9}{7}} = \log_2 \dfrac{3}{\sqrt7}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Apply the shoelace formula and simplify with \(2\log_2 3 - \log_2 7 = \log_2 \dfrac{9}{7},\) then halve the logarithm
